groups.title: Program Documents
groups.description: Core documents defining the AI Test Management Program, its operating principles, use cases, prompt standards, and controlled adoption approach.

items.title: AI Playbook for Test Managers
items.description: Primary training and operating guide covering AI-assisted test design, reporting, test data management, human review, traceability, risks, evidence, and scale readiness.
items.audience: Test Managers, QA Leads, Test Architects, Automation Engineers
items.whenToUse: Read first when joining the program or preparing a new POC.

items.title: Combined Use Case Catalog
items.description: Consolidated catalog of the program’s reusable AI-supported testing use cases, business objectives, inputs, outputs, KPI expectations, risks, and controls.
items.audience: Test Managers, POC Leads, QA Practitioners
items.whenToUse: Use when selecting or proposing an AI-supported QA workflow.

items.title: Program One-Page Summary
items.description: Management-level summary of program purpose, core POCs, expected benefits, governance position, and current readiness.
items.whenToUse: Use for stakeholder introduction and management presentations.

groups.title: Governance and Control
groups.description: Controlled documents defining ownership, approval gates, change management, incidents, and scale decisions.

items.title: Governance Center
items.description: Defines use-case lifecycle, prompt lifecycle, mandatory human review gates, incident severity, and review cadence.
items.whenToUse: Use before approving a pilot, operational use, or scale decision.

items.title: RACI Matrix
items.description: Assigns Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed roles for program scope, prompts, evidence, incidents, reporting, and scaling.
items.audience: Program Lead, Chapter Lead, POC Leads
items.whenToUse: Use when assigning ownership or resolving approval ambiguity.

items.title: Scale Decision Checklist
items.description: Mandatory checklist for ownership, data classification, workflow control, evidence quality, minimum sample, score threshold, and unresolved incidents.
items.whenToUse: Use before moving any POC to Approved for Scale.

items.title: Prompt and Workflow Change Control
items.description: Defines semantic versioning, change records, evaluation requirements, reviewer approval, rollback version, and effective date.
items.whenToUse: Use whenever prompt or workflow behavior changes.

items.title: AI Control Incident Template
items.description: Standard record for incident severity, impact, containment, evidence, root cause, corrective action, regression coverage, ownership, and closure.
items.audience: POC Leads, Security, Privacy, QA Reviewers
items.whenToUse: Use for privacy, security, traceability, release-policy, data-integrity, or material quality incidents.

groups.title: Measurement and Reporting
groups.description: Definitions and templates used to calculate program value and quality consistently.

items.title: KPI Definitions
items.description: Controlled definitions for effort reduction, cycle time, acceptance rate, traceability, arithmetic accuracy, reproducibility, defect leakage, and governance compliance.
items.audience: POC Leads, Data Analysts, QA Managers
items.whenToUse: Use before collecting metrics or comparing manual and AI-assisted workflows.

items.title: Dashboard Specification
items.description: Defines dashboard sections, source fields, calculation rules, readiness states, and drill-through expectations.
items.audience: QA Managers, BI Developers, Program Lead
items.whenToUse: Use when implementing or validating program reporting.

items.title: POC Scorecard Template
items.description: Weighted assessment of value, quality, governance, usability, support readiness, and residual risk. Scale recommendation requires an overall score of at least 80 and Governance Gate PASS.
items.whenToUse: Use after representative evidence has been collected.

groups.title: Evidence and Pilot Execution
groups.description: Guidance and templates for capturing reproducible POC results without presenting sample data as real evidence.

items.title: POC-01 Evidence Guide
items.description: Captures manual versus AI-assisted test design effort, requirement mapping, duplicate rate, reviewer disposition, unsupported behavior, and approved final suite.
items.whenToUse: Use for each representative story included in the test-case-generation pilot.

items.title: POC-02 Evidence Guide
items.description: Captures verified run metrics, report preparation time, arithmetic consistency, evidence linkage, release-policy application, and stakeholder acceptance.
items.audience: POC-02 Lead, QA Leads, Release Manager
items.whenToUse: Use for every reporting run included in the pilot sample.

items.title: POC-03 Evidence Guide
items.description: Captures preparation effort, schema and seed, valid-row conformance, negative-rule isolation, referential integrity, workbook validation, reproducibility, and privacy review.
items.audience: POC-03 Lead, Test Data Reviewers, Privacy Reviewer
items.whenToUse: Use for every generated dataset or import workbook in the pilot.

items.title: Release Checklist
items.description: Verifies content ownership, identifiers, data classification, prompt version, evidence, links, accessibility, repository checks, build status, and deployment smoke test.

groups.title: Community References
groups.description: Contributor-owned learning resources retained with attribution, permission metadata, and links to original sources.

items.title: Hải’s QA Knowledge Hub
items.description: Contributor-owned QA reference collection containing Prompt Library, Playwright, Katalon, Elasticsearch DSL, Kibana DSL Converter, career roadmaps, technical flows, guides, and attribution information.
items.audience: QA Practitioners, Test Managers, Automation Engineers
items.whenToUse: Use for self-learning, prompt discovery, technical reference, and community knowledge sharing.
